houses.name: The Grey Rhino
houses.line: Slow feet, sealed letters. Nobody reads what we write.

houses.name: Kite of the Gorge
houses.line: Speed over secrecy. By the time they read it, we are there.

houses.name: Lady of Orchids
houses.line: Let them chase the riders I want them to catch.

houses.name: Old Stripe
houses.line: Two riders, two roads. One always gets through.
